name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Outbound & GTM Automation Builder | Enrichment, Sequencing, HubSpot & AI Agents
summary: GTM systems builder who designs outbound as an automated engine, not a headcount plan. Built a segmented cold-outreach system with an automated audit workflow that scores a prospect's digital footprint and triggers personalized messaging, and wires it into the CRM end to end. Writes Python and JavaScript in automation code steps, builds AI agents where off-the-shelf tools stop, and brings 15+ years of B2B sales (BDR through top-three AE) to judge whether outreach actually sounds right.

experience.title: GTM Automation & Outbound Systems (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Built segmented cold-email outreach engines by trigger (website visibility, missed calls, low reviews), running outbound personally end to end, from list to booked meeting.
Built an automated prospect-audit workflow that scores a business's digital footprint and triggers personalized outreach; 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.
Break down manual prospecting workflows into agent architectures with custom logic, and grade AI-generated output against rubric-based evaluation criteria.

Architected 20+ GoHighLevel workflows covering lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, and reactivation, keeping every record's source and status clean in the CRM.
Connect GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and client systems through Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing Python and JavaScript in custom code steps where no-code stops.
Grew LinkedIn organically as the distribution channel for the audit offer, and write the direct-response copy and outreach sequences behind it.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran ABM-style LinkedIn campaigns against small, highly researched account lists with A/B-tested setups.
Built performance reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and produced email sequences and landing pages that improved lead generation.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%), and built automated product-training sequences that cut onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (~$130K+ total bookings), was part of a finalist-stage pursuit of a major banking prospect, and led the sales team.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria.
Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding 25+ clients per month.
